text:
mia.s: Alert — multiple customer reports of 401s and 429s when exchanging refresh tokens for access tokens in hosted (global). Started ~07:42 PDT. Some customers see transient auth failures and retries causing increased ingress load. Creating incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3182468100

sre-kai: Confirmed spike in token-issuance QPS (x6) and concurrent issuers hitting token-service p95 CPU throttling. Upstream backpressure causing 429s -> client retries -> amplification.

auth-rose: Observed org-level retry storms from a small subset of mobile SDK versions. Adding mobile-auth team and CS to thread.

mia.s: Immediate mitigations: 1) apply org-level issuance rate-limit (soft) to 5r/s per org, 2) increase token cache TTL at gateway from 30s -> 90s for access tokens, 3) spin up hot pool of token-service replicas. Rolling canary to 5% now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-config/global/issue-rl=5rps canary=5% ; auth-cache-ttl=90s ; token-svc/pool-scale=+40% (tg: auth-rolling).

sre-kai: Canary telemetry (6m): issuance errors down ~78% on canary, overall QPS starting to normalize. No increase in latency on dependent services. Proceeding to 25% if stable.

cs-lina: Notifying top-affected customers and advising mobile SDK users to upgrade. Drafting status banner.

ops-oncall: Adding temporary org-exempt list for partner integrators that need emergency relief.

auth-rose: Hot pool scaled; token-service GC pause spikes observed pre-scale — suspect memory churn from recent client-headers change. Will roll a GC tuning patch after stabilization.

sre-kai: 25% -> 100% rollout complete at 3182468148. Issuance errors down to baseline; customer reports tapering. Keeping monitoring window for 20m.

status-page-bot: Public status posted: "Investigating — elevated token issuance errors causing intermittent 401/429 for some hosted customers. Rate-limiting and scaling mitigations are being rolled out. More updates to follow." (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3182468100)

mia.s: Owners for RCA: eng-auth (auth-rose) for root cause, eng-sre (sre-kai) for mitigation/runbook, customer-success (cs-lina) for comms. Postmortem within 72h.

auth-rose: Action items: 1) patch GC + reduce mem churn, 2) add server-side exponential backoff guidance to SDKs, 3) add canary check to detect issuance QPS anomalies and automatically enable graceful degrade.

mia.s: Final public update planned after monitoring window. If you see fresh customer impact, page ops-oncall. Thanks team :raised_hands:
